boundary: Confirm Ambush on first sewer guard after MS_TOU_10_0400; skip MS_TOU_10_0500; stop when field control returns

menu_opening.reason: UpdatePreSequence @541 starts FieldCommandActionTimerHandle once after PlayFieldCommandActions. K2_SetTimerDelegate uses CRT rand even with InitialStartDelayVariance=0.
menu_opening.cancel_and_reopen: Cancelling does not undo the consumed draw; reopening through the normal action-start path consumes another one.
menu_opening.scope: Normal path-action preview opening with a valid field character/action and world; not the passive nearby-NPC button prompt.

distinction: Generic Ambush state 2 draws a weighted before-dialogue label once. This guard matches state 1 event type 20 / None and jumps to state 8, bypassing state 2.
limitations: Not a universal Ambush offset or exhaustive proof of every transitive callback. No live process capture was made by this audit.
